title: attempts/v1
description: targets/<id>/attempts.yaml (F12-R10; D-9 v3.12): the documented external attempts on a target's root statement — a prover sweep run against an upstream registry, a published attempt in a venue — each named, dated, linked and pinned to the statement content hash it actually ran on. Only entries whose hash equals the root's current hash count toward D-9's M; on a D-8 revision the count resets and the entries stay, so the record shows the attempts that no longer apply rather than deleting them. Append-only in content: a curator adds entries and never edits or removes one. Versioned, never edited (D-34).

venue.description: Where the attempt is documented: a registry, a paper, a forum.

system.description: Who or what made the attempt: a prover system and its version, or a person.

statement_hash.description: The root's statement hash the attempt ran against (D-9 v3.12's guard).

note.description: Free text; capped and served as untrusted data (F12 §7).
